title: juicy smoky aromatic middle-eastern meat ouzi
description: a flavorful and aromatic dish featuring plum sauce and kombu-cold-extract, perfect for a date night. serves 4-6 people.
instructions: season the lamb shoulder with salt, black pepper, cumin, coriander, and paprika.
heat the coconut oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat. sear the lamb shoulder until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
remove the lamb shoulder from the pot and set aside.
add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
add the plum sauce and cold-extracted kombu to the pot. stir to combine.
return the lamb shoulder to the pot and cover with a lid.
transfer the pot to the preheated oven and braise for 2.5 hours, or until the meat is tender and falls apart easily.
remove the pot from the oven and let it cool slightly.
use two forks to shred the lamb shoulder into bite-sized pieces.
return the shredded lamb to the pot and stir to combine with the plum sauce and kombu.
serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
